notes: This mapping is based on PR_ADTRANS headers and PR_ADTRANSLN lines, not PR_TASKREGLN task register transactions.
DocDesc is the allowance/deduction/premium description stored in PR_ADTRANS.
TaskCode comes from PR_ADTRANSLN line rows; task_desc is resolved from PR_TASKCODE.
Example: POTONGAN SPSI maps to task codes such as DE0005DME depending on division/charge_to.
